_comment: Hand-reviewed scoring for abilities whose measured profile (tools/ability_profiles.json) doesn't capture what they are for. Reviewed against each ability's in-game description. kind: offensive | support | self | proc | mode (empowers your other attacks for a while: scored by what you dealt during it). shots: empowered shots per cast.

ability_power_jump.note: Rain of Arrows: glide with weapon damage + multishot

ability_werewolf_transformation.note: Lycan Curse: transformation, replaces weapon and abilities

ability_baba_bench_run.note: Granny Long Legs: movement + empowered melee for the duration

citadel_ability_hornet_leap.note: Flight: weapon deals bonus spirit damage while flying

citadel_ability_wraith_rapidfire.note: Full Auto: fire rate + bonus spirit damage

ability_power_surge.note: Power Surge: bullets proc shock damage for the duration

upgrade_colossus.note: Colossus: bigger, resists, melee damage, slow aura

upgrade_infinitemagazine.note: Endless Magazine: infinite ammo + fire rate

ability_ratking_ratarmor.note: Royal Pestments: barrier (deflects are a side effect)

ability_unicorn_prismaticguard.note: Dazzling Trick: barrier, silences only when broken

ability_bounce_pad.note: Bounce Pad: mobility (landing explosion is a side effect)

ability_familiar_helpinghands.note: Lil Helpers: helpers follow allies / troopers

ability_ratking_standard_bearer.note: Rule, Ratannia!: banner buffs nearby allies

upgrade_discord.note: Scourge: aura on a friendly target (can self-cast)

citadel_ability_melee_parry.note: Parry: defensive reaction; scored in the melee view (parries made / got parried)

_nurse: Nurse Harrow (2026-10-20). stack_modifier: a stacking buff on the caster shown as a counter (leeches). debuff_modifier: an enemy debuff counted per cast (feared heroes). loadout: the ability swaps the gun for another weapon (healing syringes); scored by syringes fired and allies they reached.

ability_nurse_leech_therapy.note: Leech Therapy: jar of leeches (damage over time); picked-up leeches stack permanently

ability_nurse_adrenaline_rush.note: Wretched Vapors: rush then crash on yourself or an ally

ability_nurse_healing_needles.note: Healing Needles: a clip of syringes that heal allies

ability_nurse_fear.note: Lurking Terrors: 1.3 s buildup + 7 s channel; fear is the payoff

citadel_weapon_nurse_healing_needles.name: Healing Needles (syringes)
citadel_weapon_nurse_healing_needles.note: the syringe gun: shots heal allies, not gun accuracy
